issue_context.title: Replace guava LoadingCache with caffeine LoadingCache in proxy service
issue_context.body: 1. Please describe the issue you observed: In proxy ClusterMetadataService, we use guava LoadingCache to cache topicConfig and subscriptionGroupConfig In proxy TopicRouteService, we use caffeine LoadingCache to cache topic MessageQueueView Factually, we may replace guava cache with caffeine, which is compatible and performs better.
